name: Table Foot
description: The summary rowgroup — for md-table. A marker element that groups totals and aggregate rows. md-table reads it to give those rows the footer surface and its own top divider, and to keep them out of the selection model. It has no author-settable props and no box of its own.

notes: Dedicated native md-table family (one table model: grid tracks, column template, row groups, sticky / frozen header, pinning, selection, expansion, FLIP motion). The foot row group (sticky footer from the table).

macOS SwiftUI, the iOS simulator and the Android emulator are verified against Mac Chrome 153: 118 paint cases (geometry, colours, density, RTL, dark, forced colours, hooks), 19 interaction runs frame by frame (hover, selection, expansion, sorting with the consumer, pagination, keyboard and Tab order, frozen-body and container scrolling, loading / empty, pinning / visibility, toolbar auto-bind, reduced motion).
